title: The Lord Looks at the Heart
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The Lord sent Samuel out to find
A king from Jesse's sons.
The oldest son stood tall and strong,
But God said, "Not this one."

[Chorus]
The Lord looks at your heart, my child,
Not if you're big or small.
So keep it kind and true and good,
He loves that most of all.

[Verse 2]
"You see the outside," said the Lord,
"But I look at the heart."
Then David came in from the sheep,
God chose him from the start.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
So close your eyes, my little lamb,
The stars are shining bright.
The Lord who chose the shepherd boy
Sees your good heart tonight.

[Chorus]
mood: Hillside music. A soft, floating sway drifts under the voice, wide and open, like a quiet pasture at dusk where a small shepherd boy watches his sheep. The first verses hold a hushed wonder as each tall brother passes and the smallest is chosen, the sway staying tender and light. By the last verse it slows and sinks lower, thinning to a stillness like starlight over a sleeping flock.
